title: Budget boundary comparison regression
question: Review the proposed change from >= to > at a call budget boundary. Explain the counter comparison and propose equality-boundary checks; treat all runtime outcomes as unmeasured.

input.question: Review the proposed change from >= to > at a call budget boundary. Explain the counter comparison and propose equality-boundary checks; treat all runtime outcomes as unmeasured.
input.context:
# Proposed patch for static review only; not applied or executed.
--- a/triage_desk/agent_budget.py
+++ b/triage_desk/agent_budget.py
@@ -1,24 +1,24 @@
     @contextmanager
     def call(self, phase, name):
         with self.lock:
             self.check()
             field = 'model_calls' if phase == 'model' else 'tool_calls'
             maximum = self.max_model_calls if phase == 'model' else self.max_tool_calls
-            if getattr(self, field) >= maximum:
+            if getattr(self, field) > maximum:
                 raise BudgetExceeded(f'The investigation reached its {phase}-call limit.')
             setattr(self, field, getattr(self, field) + 1)
         started = time.monotonic()
         # Do not persist tool arguments: they can include user code or credentials.
         call_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
         self.event(phase=phase, name=name, status='started', call_id=call_id)
         event = {'phase': phase + '_result', 'name': name, 'status': 'completed', 'call_id': call_id,
                  'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
         try:
             yield event
         except Exception as exc:
             event['status'] = 'limited' if isinstance(exc, BudgetExceeded) else 'error'
             event['error_type'] = type(exc).__name__
             raise
         finally:
             event['latency_ms'] = round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 2)
             self.event(**event)
